title: Help tells members to tap a Muscles ready today card that was switched off on 5 Nov
what: A member who asks the help box about quick workouts or which muscles are ready is told to open the Workout tab and tap the Muscles ready today card, then Quick workout for the time you have. That card was taken off the Workout tab on 5 Nov and nothing in the app opens either page, so the member looks for a card that is not there.
expected: Help only describes things a member can open today. A switched-off thing is left out of help until it comes back.
who: members who ask help about quick workouts or rested muscles
how_often: every time help answers from that page
fix_line: Mark that help page as not released, the same way the MettleUp Plus help pages are held back
